name: wisp-gym-promo
description: Silent motion-graphics promo for Wisp Gym (Remotion)

scripts.assets: mkdir -p public/shots && cp ../../docs/screenshots/*.jpg public/shots/ && cp ../../entry/src/main/resources/rawfile/fonts/Nunito-*.ttf public/ && cp ../../docs/app-icon.png public/logo.png && NODE_PATH=${NODE_PATH:-$HOME/.wisp-gym-tools/node_modules} node scripts/creatures.mjs
scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts WispPromo out/wisp-gym-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --muted
